title: Duels Before the Gu Realm
summary: In Ancient Holy City, Xiao Yan accepts Yang Hao's challenge and beats him with a Soul Attack and the new Earth Flame Hurricane. Lin Xiu tries to start another fight until Elder Gu Xun stops it and says the Gu Realm opens in three days. Hun Ya of the Hun Clan comes to taunt Xiao Yan, saying his ancestor killed Xiao Xuan, and Xiao Yan vows revenge. Huo Xuan and Huo Zhi of the Yan Clan tell him about the Heavenly Tomb, where ancient powerhouses are buried, and point out Yao Xing Ji of the Yao Clan. Gu Zhen, chief commander of the Black Submerged Army, tells Xiao Yan only a Dou Sheng can make the clan ignore bloodline purity, and Xiao Yan says he will become one. In the Gu Realm, Xun Er welcomes him and drives off elders who test him with an attack. Mr. Ling warns that anyone at the coming-of-age ceremony may challenge him.
events: Xiao Yan defeats Yang Hao with a Soul Attack and the Earth Flame Hurricane.

cultivation: Narration: Ling Quan is a 1-star Dou Zun, ranked seventh of the eight commanders; a Black Submerged King must be Ban Sheng level. Huo Xuan calls Xiao Yan 'just a Five-Star Dou Zun'. Yao Xing Ji is an eight-tier middle rank alchemist.
